title: Generalized Lyubeznik-to-Barile–Macchia resolution conjecture
statement: Let $I$ be a monomial ideal. A minimal generalized Lyubeznik resolution and a minimal generalized Barile–Macchia resolution are resolutions of $I$ with the indicated generalized constructions and minimality properties. **Generalized Lyubeznik-to-Barile–Macchia conjecture.** If $I$ has a minimal generalized Lyubeznik resolution, then $I$ also has a minimal generalized Barile–Macchia resolution. The conjecture proposes that the existence of the former resolution guarantees the existence of the latter; the supplied text does not indicate whether it has been resolved.
source_name: Trung Chau, Huy Tai Ha and Aryaman Maithani, “Monomial ideals with minimal generalized Barile-Macchia resolutions”, arXiv:2412.11843 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.11843
